description: Retrieve empirical labour-market research data from /research (role x seniority salary heatmaps, Mincerian OLS log-wage regression with White HC1 SEs, ANOVA variance decomposition, Blinder-Oaxaca decomposition, Gini/Theil/HHI inequality metrics, cross-market PPP comparison, and freelance order budget shares).

period.description: Optional monthly archive snapshot YYYY-MM (default: live 30-day rolling report)

role.description: Optional role slug (e.g. "backend", "frontend", "devops", "qa", "ai") to fetch detailed pay slices for one specialization

section.description: Optional section slice: "all" (default), "econometrics" (Mincer OLS, ANOVA, Oaxaca, Gini, PPP), or "gigs" (freelance order budgets and task transformation)

name: get_research_report
